page.layout: One page of text: a bordered table of names with years in a right column, and marginal notes in the left margin. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.l: Iidem | 1570 Arx Groningæ extrui cæpta ab Hispanicis.
Iidem | 1571 Decretum ALBANI de iure stapulæ.

Albert Rolteman, | 1576 Ordines agrarii fœderi antiquo cum civitate Gron. renunciant mense Ianuario. PAX GANDAVENSIS. Caspar Roblef, à militibus suis captus, Arx Groningæ diruta, Deleƈti [?] ordinum agrariorū Groningæ in custodiam liberam dati, anno vergente.

page.notes: The years 1569 to 1577 stand in a separate right-hand column; each is set on the first line of its block. The left-margin notes run beside the rows: the first beside 1570, the second beside 1571, and the long block beside 1576. The word "Deleƈti" in the last note is doubtful, as is "vergente", which is partly obscured by the table rule. The names in the table are italic, and "Iidem" is roman.
